column.name: description
column.value: Operational multi-tranche pipeline. Survey approval is recorded by the external application. Cancelled tranches stay blank until a manual-review decision is recorded.

insert.column: WITH scoped_loan AS ( SELECT ml.id AS loan_id FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id AND lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 1 AND COALESCE(lp.require_milestone_survey, 0) = 1 LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office branch ON branch.id = COALESCE(ml.office_id, mc.office_id) JOIN m_office scope_office ON branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(scope_office.hierarchy, '%') WHERE (scope_office.id = ${officeId} OR (${officeId} IN (-1, 0) AND scope_office.hierarchy = '${currentUserHierarchy}')) AND (ml.loan_officer_id = ${investmentOfficerId} OR ${investmentOfficerId} IN (-1, -10, 0)) AND (ml.product_id = ${loanProductId} OR ${loanProductId} IN (-1, 0)) AND (ml.loan_status_id = ${loanStatusId} OR ${loanStatusId} = -1) ), first_disb AS ( SELECT loan_id, principal, disbursedon_date FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.principal, d.disbursedon_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id WHERE d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), second_disb AS ( SELECT loan_id, principal, disbursedon_date, COALESCE(NULLIF(receipt_number, ''), NULLIF(check_number, '')) AS payment_reference FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.principal, d.disbursedon_date, d.receipt_number, d.check_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id WHERE d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 2 ), next_open AS ( SELECT loan_id, id, principal FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.id, d.principal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.expected_disburse_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id WHERE d.disbursedon_date IS NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), first_due AS ( SELECT rs.loan_id, rs.duedate, COALESCE(rs.principal_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.interest_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_amount, 0) AS due_amount, COALESCE(rs.principal_completed_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.interest_completed_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0) AS paid_amount, rs.obligations_met_on_date AS received_on FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = rs.loan_id JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = l.id WHERE rs.installment = COALESCE(l.grace_on_principal_periods, 0) + 1 ), pipeline AS ( SELECT ml.id AS loanId, ml.account_no AS loanAccountNumber, mc.id AS clientId, mc.display_name AS clientName, country_office.name AS country, entity_office.name AS entity, branch.name AS branch, ms.display_name AS loanOfficer, lp.name AS productName, ml.approved_principal AS approvedPrincipal, first_disb.principal AS firstTrancheDisbursedAmount, first_disb.disbursedon_date AS firstTrancheDisbursedDate, first_due.duedate AS firstRepaymentDueDate, first_due.due_amount AS firstRepaymentDueAmount, first_due.received_on AS firstRepaymentReceivedDate, first_due.paid_amount AS firstRepaymentReceivedAmount, mile.operational_status AS bgsOperationalStatus, mile.operational_verified_by_bgs AS bgsOperationalVerified, mile.operational_bgs_name AS bgsOperationalVerifier, mile.additional_funding AS bgsFundingStatus, mile.funding_verified_by_bgs AS bgsFundingVerified, mile.funding_bgs_name AS bgsFundingVerifier, mile.operational_verified_by_investment AS investmentOperationalVerified, mile.operational_investment_name AS investmentOperationalVerifier, mile.funding_verified_by_investment AS investmentFundingVerified, mile.funding_investment_name AS investmentFundingVerifier, CASE WHEN second_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 440 THEN 5 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 450 THEN 6 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 AND next_open.id IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 420 AND next_open.id IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN first_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL AND next_open.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 7 END AS pipelineStatusId, CASE WHEN second_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Disbursed' WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 440 THEN 'Expired' WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 450 THEN 'Manual review' WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 AND next_open.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Approved awaiting disbursement' WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 420 AND next_open.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Eligible awaiting approval' WHEN first_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL AND next_open.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Awaiting verification' ELSE 'Approved' END AS secondTrancheEligibilityStatus, CASE WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 THEN next_open.principal END AS secondTrancheApprovedAmount, first_due.duedate AS secondTrancheDeadlineDate, CASE WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 THEN 'Approved' ELSE 'Pending' END AS approvalStatus, CASE WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 THEN mile.conducted_by END AS approver, CASE WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 THEN mile.conducted_on END AS approvedOn, second_disb.disbursedon_date AS secondTrancheDisbursementDate, second_disb.payment_reference AS secondTranchePaymentReference, CASE ml.loan_sub_status_id WHEN 440 THEN 'Expired' WHEN 450 THEN 'Manual review' ELSE '' END AS expiryReviewStatus, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(200)) AS cancellationReason, ml.principal_outstanding_derived AS outstandingPrincipal, ml.total_outstanding_derived AS totalLoanBalance, CASE ml.loan_status_id WHEN 100 THEN 'Submitted and pending approval' WHEN 200 THEN 'Approved' WHEN 300 THEN 'Active' WHEN 400 THEN 'Withdrawn by client' WHEN 500 THEN 'Rejected' WHEN 600 THEN 'Closed' WHEN 601 THEN 'Written off' WHEN 602 THEN 'Rescheduled' WHEN 700 THEN 'Overpaid' ELSE CAST(ml.loan_status_id AS CHAR) END AS loanStatus, first_due.duedate AS eligibilityDeadline FROM scoped_loan s JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = s.loan_id JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office branch ON branch.id = COALESCE(ml.office_id, mc.office_id) LEFT JOIN m_office country_office ON country_office.parent_id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM m_office WHERE parent_id IS NULL) AND branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(country_office.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_office entity_office ON entity_office.parent_id = country_office.id AND branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(entity_office.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN first_disb ON first_disb.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN second_disb ON second_disb.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN next_open ON next_open.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN first_due ON first_due.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_tranche_milestone mile ON mile.loan_id = ml.id AND mile.disbursement_detail_id = COALESCE(next_open.id, second_disb.id) WHERE (${countryOfficeId} = -1 OR country_office.id = ${countryOfficeId}) AND (${entityOfficeId} = -1 OR entity_office.id = ${entityOfficeId}) AND COALESCE(first_disb.disbursedon_date, ml.approvedon_date) BETWEEN DATE('${startDate}') AND DATE('${endDate}') ) SELECT ${currentDate} AS asOfDate, NOW() AS generatedOn, report_user.username AS generatedBy, report_office.name AS generatedByOffice, ${officeId} AS filterOfficeId, ${countryOfficeId} AS filterCountryOfficeId, ${entityOfficeId} AS filterEntityOfficeId, ${investmentOfficerId} AS filterInvestmentOfficerId, ${loanProductId} AS filterProductId, ${loanStatusId} AS filterLoanStatusId, ${pipelineStatusId} AS filterPipelineStatusId, ${deadlineProximity} AS filterDeadlineProximity, '${startDate}' AS filterFromDate, '${endDate}' AS filterToDate, pipeline.* FROM pipeline JOIN m_appuser report_user ON report_user.id = ${currentUserId} JOIN m_office report_office ON report_office.id = report_user.office_id WHERE (${pipelineStatusId} = -1 OR pipeline.pipelineStatusId = ${pipelineStatusId}) AND ( ${deadlineProximity} = -1 OR (${deadlineProximity} = 7 AND pipeline.eligibilityDeadline BETWEEN ${currentDate} AND DATE_ADD(${currentDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) OR (${deadlineProximity} = 14 AND pipeline.eligibilityDeadline BETWEEN ${currentDate} AND DATE_ADD(${currentDate}, INTERVAL 14 DAY)) OR (${deadlineProximity} = 1 AND pipeline.eligibilityDeadline < ${currentDate}) ) ORDER BY pipeline.loanAccountNumber

select count(*) from stretchy_report where report_name = 'Multi-tranche amounts'

column.name: description
column.value: Approved, disbursed, and undisbursed multi-tranche amounts by country, entity, product, officer, and month.

insert.column: SELECT ${currentDate} AS asOfDate, NOW() AS generatedOn, MAX(report_user.username) AS generatedBy, MAX(report_office.name) AS generatedByOffice, '${startDate}' AS filterFromDate, '${endDate}' AS filterToDate, country_office.name AS country, entity_office.name AS entity, lp.name AS productName, ms.display_name AS loanOfficer, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(first_disb.disbursedon_date, ml.approvedon_date), '%Y-%m') AS periodMonth, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(ml.approved_principal) AS approvedAmount, SUM(COALESCE(ml.principal_disbursed_derived, 0)) AS disbursedAmount, SUM(GREATEST(ml.approved_principal - COALESCE(ml.principal_disbursed_derived, 0), 0)) AS undisbursedAmount FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id AND lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 1 AND COALESCE(lp.require_milestone_survey, 0) = 1 LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office branch ON branch.id = COALESCE(ml.office_id, mc.office_id) JOIN m_office scope_office ON branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(scope_office.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_office country_office ON country_office.parent_id = (SELECT MIN(id) FROM m_office WHERE parent_id IS NULL) AND branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(country_office.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_office entity_office ON entity_office.parent_id = country_office.id AND branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(entity_office.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT loan_id, disbursedon_date FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.disbursedon_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d WHERE d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) first_disb ON first_disb.loan_id = ml.id JOIN m_appuser report_user ON report_user.id = ${currentUserId} JOIN m_office report_office ON report_office.id = report_user.office_id WHERE (scope_office.id = ${officeId} OR (${officeId} IN (-1, 0) AND scope_office.hierarchy = '${currentUserHierarchy}')) AND (ml.loan_officer_id = ${investmentOfficerId} OR ${investmentOfficerId} IN (-1, -10, 0)) AND (ml.product_id = ${loanProductId} OR ${loanProductId} IN (-1, 0)) AND (${countryOfficeId} = -1 OR country_office.id = ${countryOfficeId}) AND (${entityOfficeId} = -1 OR entity_office.id = ${entityOfficeId}) AND COALESCE(first_disb.disbursedon_date, ml.approvedon_date) BETWEEN DATE('${startDate}') AND DATE('${endDate}') GROUP BY country, entity, productName, loanOfficer, periodMonth ORDER BY country, entity, productName, loanOfficer, periodMonth
